[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Enemies all gain hidden modifier, towers gain a 10% boost to range|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''The Moon''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it boosts both enemies and towers. ==Effects== When applied, all enemies become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], meaning they require hidden detection to be targeted. To compensate, all towers receive a 10% [[Range Buff]]. ==Trivia== *'''The Moon''' is based on the [[wp:The Moon (tarot card)|The Moon]] tarot card. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''The Moon''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''The Moon''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
